@Usage:@: @   2. Copy pico.js/css, index.html/js from pico to public directory.                            @
@   3. Build app.js on each pico/$app directories.                                               @
@   4. Copy pico.js/css, index.html/js from each pico/$app to public/$app directories.           @
@   Deploy public directory to saikororg on firebase.                                            @
scripts.build:lib: pushd pico; npm run build --out=../public; popd
scripts.build:app: pushd pico; for app in dice clock bank kuku chess shogi; do npm run build --out=../public/$app --main=app/$app/app.js; done; popd
scripts.build: npm run build:lib; npm run build:menu; npm run build:app
